Rule description: Instrument: NIFTY 50 spot index; chart timeframe 5 minutes
Implementation: data_access.load_window; opening_candle.aggregate_5m

Rule description: Signal candle = first 5-minute candle 09:15-09:20; decision at 09:20 only after the candle has closed
Implementation: opening_candle.opening_candle (confirmed_at = 09:20)

Rule description: BUY and SELL directions
Implementation: signal_engine.evaluate_session

Rule description: One decision and at most one trade per session; no entry at 09:25/09:30/later; no re-entry after stop or target
Implementation: backtest.run (one SessionData per date); execution.simulate (single position)

Rule description: Decision flow order: gap, EMA direction, previous-day level, colour + pattern, wick; any failure ends the day
Implementation: signal_engine.evaluate_session (all conditions evaluated, no short-circuit; the outcome equals the ordered flow)

Rule description: Trend filter: 200-period EMA on the 5-minute chart; BUY above, SELL below; never trade against it
Implementation: ema.ema_series; signal_engine (direction_by_ema)

Rule description: Compare the close of the 9:20 candle with the EMA value ON THAT SAME candle (marked TO CONFIRM)
Implementation: ema_now includes the opening candle's own close (TradingView convention; EMA labels reproduced within 0.25 pt)

Rule description: A fresh EMA cross is allowed (candle starts beyond/at the other side and closes beyond it)
Implementation: signal_engine.ema_scenario (A already beyond, B intrabar cross, C overnight-gap cross; all eligible)

Rule description: Overnight-gap cross treated like an intrabar cross (the rulebook does not distinguish them)
Implementation: signal_engine.ema_scenario label C is eligible; distinction recorded, not enforced

Rule description: Close exactly on the EMA: no trade
Implementation: signal_engine (|close-EMA| <= 1e-9 -> EMA_EQUAL)

Rule description: Previous-day levels: MAJOR = top (resistance) / bottom (support) of the previous day; INNER = smaller levels inside it
Implementation: levels.major_levels (previous-day high/low as single prices; zone edges of a major level are not defined)

Rule description: Breaking ANY ONE previous-day level, major or inner, is enough (the major need not break)
Implementation: signal_engine (any broken level qualifies; qualifying_category MAJOR_ONLY / INNER_ONLY / MAJOR_AND_INNER)

Rule description: A break = the 09:20 candle closes beyond the level; a wick poking through does not count (marked TO CONFIRM)
Implementation: zones.broken (close beyond; boundary STRICT, configurable)

Rule description: Zone: BUY break = close above the top edge; SELL break = close below the bottom edge (TO CONFIRM)
Implementation: zones.broken (ceiling for resistance, floor for support; zone never collapsed to a point)

Rule description: How inner levels are found is 'not yet defined'
Implementation: levels.inner_levels: SWING_FRACTAL_WICK_ZONE (A,B,D) and CLUSTER_ZONE (C), both PROVISIONAL, independently selectable

Rule description: Must the candle cross the level from the old side, or is closing beyond it (even after a gap) enough? Not stated; the 'close beyond' wording and Example 2 (no level drawn, open above the previous high) support the literal reading
Implementation: config.break_mode: CLOSE_BEYOND (reference) vs OPEN_ON_OLD_SIDE_AND_CLOSE_BEYOND (diagnostic DIAG-A-OLDSIDE)

Rule description: Candle colour matches the direction: green (close > open) for BUY, red (close < open) for SELL
Implementation: patterns.colour_ok

Rule description: Wrong-side wick <= 20% of the WHOLE candle range: BUY upper wick (H - max(O,C)), SELL lower wick (min(O,C) - L); 20% adjustable (MAX_BAD_WICK_PCT)
Implementation: patterns.bad_wick_pct / wick_ok; config.max_bad_wick_pct

Rule description: At least one pattern: hammer / engulfing / full-body (BUY); shooting star / engulfing / full-body (SELL)
Implementation: patterns.evaluate

Rule description: Full-body candle: right colour and total wick (upper + lower) <= 20% of range
Implementation: patterns.full_body

Rule description: Hammer / shooting-star exact proportions ('still to be defined')
Implementation: patterns.pin_bar: long-side wick >= 2 x body and opposite wick <= 10% of range

Rule description: Engulfing: which candle is 'previous' at 09:20 ('still to be defined')
Implementation: A/B/C: previous session's last continuous 5-minute candle (labelled PROVISIONAL); D: engulfing not evaluated (config.engulf_reference)

Rule description: Zero-range candle (high = low) is rejected
Implementation: signal_engine ZERO_RANGE_CANDLE; patterns.metrics

Rule description: Gap = 9:15 open - previous day close, up or down; no trade if |gap| > limit; both BUY and SELL (which 'previous close' - official daily close or last chart close - is not stated)
Implementation: gap_filter (first 1-minute open minus the OFFICIAL daily close; equal to the limit passes)

Rule description: Maximum gap is 250 or 300 points - final value to be chosen (MAX_GAP_POINTS adjustable)
Implementation: ORB-V2-A = 250, ORB-V2-B = 300, both fixed scenarios

Rule description: Entry price = close of the 9:15 candle (marked TO CONFIRM)
Implementation: execution: first causally executable fill = OPEN of the 09:20 one-minute bar (the candle close is stored as entry_vs_candle_close)

Rule description: Stop-loss 30 points, target 60 points (1:2), in index points
Implementation: config.stop_points / target_points; execution.simulate

Rule description: Stop and target both touched inside one candle: unknown order; conservative default = stop first (TO CONFIRM)
Implementation: execution: same ONE-MINUTE bar, STOP_FIRST; alternative stored as alt_* (no collision occurred in the primary run)

Rule description: If neither is hit close at the end of the session; time TO BE CONFIRMED (example 3:15 PM)
Implementation: execution: forced exit at the open of the 15:14 bar (repo FORCED-EXIT-001, provisional); never at/after 15:15; no closing-auction fills

Rule description: Examples 2 and 3 contradict the written wick rule; 'the rule as written applies until confirmed'
Implementation: no rule loosened; both examples reconstructed (original_examples_reconstruction.md)

Rule description: Legacy ORB (old PDF): Method 1 / Method 2 / Gap-200DMA, prior-session EMA trend, strength proportions
Implementation: NOT used; the V2 package imports none of it

Rule description: Options execution (BUY CE for bullish, PE for bearish) is a future model; no historical option data is available
Implementation: not implemented; P&L is synthetic index points
